# fyre_clusters (Data Source)

Fetches a list of clusters for the authenticated user.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site location (svl or rtp). Defaults to 'svl' or inherits from provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_count` (Number) Total number of clusters
- `clusters` (Attributes List) List of clusters (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))
- `id` (String) Data source identifier

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) Cluster creation timestamp
- `description` (String) Cluster description
- `id` (Number) Cluster ID
- `name` (String) Cluster name
- `updated` (String) Cluster last update timestamp
- `vm_count` (Number) Number of VMs in the cluster
